training_principles.description: Work in a set rep range. Once you hit the top for all sets, increase weight next session. Reps first, then weight.
10 sets × 10 reps with minimal rest. Used on machine chest press (Day 1) and chest-supported rows (Day 2). Brutal volume stimulus.
Move exercise to exercise with no rest within the cluster. Only rest between full rounds. Maximizes pump and time efficiency.
3-4 seconds down, 1s pause at stretch, explode up. Especially on incline press. More time under tension = more hypertrophy.
Quality reps over ego weight. Feel the target muscle working. CBum prioritizes a hard contraction at the top of every rep.
Full stretch at the bottom, full contraction at the top. This is CBum's 2024 emphasis across ALL muscle groups.
CBum dropped these to stay pain-free as he ages. Belt squat, hack squat, and pendulum squat replace them with zero spine load.
CBum's weak points (biceps + calves) get special intensity techniques — Fat Gripz, more volume, drop sets built into the program.

training_tags_explained.GVT: German Volume Training (10 sets × 10 reps with minimal rest)
training_tags_explained.TRI-SET A: Triceps or first muscle group in cluster (no rest within)
training_tags_explained.STRAIGHT SETS: Standard set structure with rest between sets

program_adaptations.note: CBum is a 6× Olympia champion with full-time recovery. The structure and principles are what matter.
recommendations: Start with straight sets before adding GVT
Tri-sets, double progression, slow eccentrics, and extended ROM are directly transferable
Prioritize mind-muscle connection over ego lifting
Adapt exercise selection based on equipment availability and joint health
